description: gasflow is a Python library for natural-gas properties and simple pipeline calculations. Its example computes density, compressibility and heat capacity, then pressure and temperature profiles using a steady pipeline solver. The provider is codingmagical (repository owner). Coverage: The README illustrates one parameterised pipeline. It does not establish geographic coverage, measurement dates or validation across network topologies. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The repository identifies Apache 2.0 for code. Input and dependency conditions are separate. Limitations: The short example does not establish transient or meshed-network capability. Independent reuse and maintenance were not verified. For simulation it supports experimental gas-property and single-pipe calculations. Related resources: model-pandapipes provides a separate network-modelling reference; it is not evidence that this library uses pandapipes.
